name: HyperFlow H3 Flash Ref2VA
description: Generate video and audio with reference images. Use the HyperFlow H3 Flash Ref2VA transformer; video/audio references are not validated for these weights. Reuses MiniMax-H3 components with either the MiniMax-H3 Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder or Qwen3-VL-4B with the P-H3 text connector and the HyperFlow 6-step schedule. Reference images need the matching vision tower. Audio VAE is optional for silent video.

slots.label: MiniMax-H3 Qwen 3 VL 32B or P-H3 Qwen 3 VL 4B Text Encoder
Vision tower (required for reference images when not included in the text encoder)
P-H3 Text Connector (for Qwen 3 VL 4B, when not included in the text encoder)
